q.g: In this quest you have to kill Glukhar and hand over 2 found in raid helmets of class 4 or higher. You can hand over any of the following helmets: * Altyn assault helmet (Olive Drab) * Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 bulletproof helmet (Black) * HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Black) * HighCom Striker ULACH IIIA helmet (Desert Tan) * MSA Gallet TC 800 High Cut combat helmet (Black) * Ops-Core FAST MT Super High Cut helmet (Black) * BNTI LShZ-2DTM helmet (Black) * Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet (Olive Drab) * MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Olive Drab) * 6B47 Ratnik-BSh helmet (EMR cover) * NPP KlASS Tor-2 helmet (Olive Drab) * NFM HJELM helmet (Hellhound Grey) * ZSh-1-2M helmet (Black cover) * ZSh-1-2M helmet (Olive Drab)
